corrections.reason: The printed Ge'ez text clearly has 1st-order ጸ (ይጸሊ, imperfective 'from where he was praying'), without a 5th-order ጼ loop.
The section heading prints the verbal noun in the 6th order (አግብኦት) followed by the analytic genitive ዘይሁዳ, with no 2nd-order -u stroke on ት.
Parallel to አግብኦት ዘይሁዳ on the preceding line, the printed glyph is 6th-order ት (ተአኅዞት ዘኢየሱስ) without a 2nd-order -u marker.
